name: The Legend of The Bone Sword RPG
desc:
Embark on a perilous journey to reclaim your homeland from the Bone Lord's evil grasp. Progress through unique worlds and challenges as you grow stronger and collect strange weapons.

But things are not as they seem. Chaos lingers above, waiting to possess you at your darkest hour. How could you let this happen?

This game is a work in progress, please report any issues.
The old version is still available to play, just follow the floating platforms in The Old Sanctuary.
The classic version - https://www.roblox.com/games/6536023653/
